# Wiring tables (generated)

Reference board: **ESP32-DevKitC (ESP32-WROOM-32, classic ESP32)** · logic 3.3 V, GPIO NOT 5 V tolerant.

ADC2 cannot be used while Wi-Fi is active: every analog input is on ADC1. GPIO12 strapping sets flash voltage — never pulled high at boot. Input-only pins have no internal pull-ups.

## Profile CORE

Board: **ESP32-DevKitC (ESP32-WROOM-32, classic ESP32)**

Minimum custody demo: RFID + presence (HC-SR04, IR) + DHT22 + flame; optional servo gate + RGB status.

| Component | Signal | Dir | ESP32 GPIO | Supply | Logic level | Required circuit | Firmware symbol |

| RC522 RFID | SCK | out | 18 (SPI_VSPI, shared) | 3.3 V ONLY | 3.3 V | direct | `PIN_SPI_SCK` |
| RC522 RFID | MISO | in | 19 (SPI_VSPI, shared) | 3.3 V | 3.3 V | direct | `PIN_SPI_MISO` |
| RC522 RFID | MOSI | out | 23 (SPI_VSPI, shared) | 3.3 V | 3.3 V | direct | `PIN_SPI_MOSI` |
| RC522 RFID | SDA/SS (chip select) | out | 21 | 3.3 V | 3.3 V | direct | `PIN_RFID_SS` |
| RC522 RFID | RST | out | 22 | 3.3 V | 3.3 V | direct; IRQ not connected | `PIN_RFID_RST` |
| DHT22 | DATA | io | 4 | 3.3 V | 3.3 V | 10 kΩ pull-up DATA→3.3 V if the module has none | `PIN_DHT` |
| HC-SR04 | TRIG | out | 26 | 5 V | 3.3 V drive (accepted by most modules — verify) | direct | `PIN_US_TRIG` |
| HC-SR04 | ECHO | in | 34 | 5 V | 5 V → 3.3 V | divider ECHO—10 kΩ—GPIO34—20 kΩ—GND (≈3.3 V) | `PIN_US_ECHO` |

| Flame module | DO (active LOW) | in | 39 | 3.3 V | 3.3 V | power from 3.3 V; set threshold pot with a safe IR stimulus (TV remote), not a flame; 100 kΩ pull-DOWN on DO so a disconnected module reads 'flame-like' (fail-safe, visible) | `PIN_FLAME` |
| MG995/MG996R servo | PWM | out | 13 | EXTERNAL 5–6 V ≥2.5 A (stall) | 3.3 V PWM | servo V+ from external supply; common GND with ESP32; 470–1000 µF bulk cap at servo; never from ESP32 5V/3V3 pin | `PIN_SERVO` |
| RGB LED (common anode) | R | out | 25 | anode → 3.3 V | active LOW | 220 Ω series | `PIN_LED_R` |
| RGB LED (common anode) | G | out | 33 | anode → 3.3 V | active LOW | 220 Ω series (green/blue: 100–150 Ω for brightness) | `PIN_LED_G` |
| RGB LED (common anode) | B | out | 32 | anode → 3.3 V | active LOW | 220 Ω series | `PIN_LED_B` |
| BOOT button (on board) | manual stop | in | 0 | board | active LOW | on-board button; read only after boot | `PIN_MANUAL_STOP` |
